hypotheses.justification: This instance can be deleted while leaving the statement well-typed. `DiscreteCoind` is defined using only `[Group G]` and `[TopologicalSpace G]` (with the subgroup and coefficient action), and `homogeneous2` uses only the group and action structure. The displayed `simp` proof uses the defining formula and coinduced-function equivariance, neither of which requires a topological-group law. Thus the theorem remains true for any topology on `G`, including degenerate cases.
